summary.en: Sponsorship for individuals and families facing essential medical needs.

description.en:
Illness or injury can bring sudden costs that a family is unable to meet alone. Majeedia Trust sponsors individuals and families facing essential medical needs.

Each situation is assessed with care and in confidence, and support is given discreetly so that the privacy and dignity of every patient and their family are protected.

imageAlt.en: A doctor with a stethoscope talking with a patient across a desk in a hospital consulting room

summary.en: Support for children and students, including orphans, who need assistance with their education.

description.en:
Education opens doors that last a lifetime. Majeedia Trust supports children and students who need assistance with their education, including orphans and children whose families face difficult circumstances.

Support is assessed individually so that it meets a real educational need and helps a young person continue learning.

imageAlt.en: Children sitting on the carpet of a mosque as a teacher writes on the blackboard, the girls in headscarves

summary.en: Support for madrasa education, students and related educational needs.

description.en:
Religious learning has an important place in many families and communities. Majeedia Trust supports madrasa education, its students and related educational needs.

As with all support, needs are assessed before resources are allocated.

imageAlt.en: Seen from above, two girls in headscarves reading the Quran on prayer mats

summary.en: Sponsorship for girls memorising the Holy Quran through Hifz programmes.

description.en:
Memorising the Holy Quran is a lifelong blessing for a girl, her family and her community. Majeedia Trust sponsors girls enrolled in Hifz programmes so that they can continue their memorisation.

Support is considered carefully, with the aim of helping each girl complete her Hifz with dignity and consistency.

imageAlt.en: Girls in headscarves writing in their exercise books at a classroom desk

summary.en: Support for people with disabilities and families dealing with disability-related needs.

description.en:
Disability can bring additional costs and challenges for individuals and the families who care for them. Majeedia Trust supports people with disabilities and families dealing with disability-related needs.

We approach every request with respect, focusing on practical support that helps people live with greater independence and dignity.

imageAlt.en: Two women in headscarves helping a woman in a wheelchair along a sandy path

summary.en: Support for carefully assessed family and community welfare requirements.

description.en:
Families sometimes face circumstances they cannot manage alone, and communities have shared needs that benefit everyone. Majeedia Trust supports carefully assessed family and community welfare requirements.

Each request is considered on its own merits, with the aim of providing meaningful and responsible help.

imageAlt.en: Three young women in headscarves smiling as they read a sheet of paper together

summary.en: Support for selected mosque and community infrastructure projects.

description.en:
A masjid is often a centre of community life: a place of prayer, learning and gathering. Majeedia Trust supports selected mosque and community infrastructure projects.

Projects are selected carefully, and their costs, including maintenance, are recorded as part of the family fund’s documentation.

imageAlt.en: Families walking towards a brick mosque with a minaret and a softly lit entrance at sunset

summary.en: Sponsorship for the upkeep and maintenance of schools serving the community.

description.en:
A safe, well-kept school helps children learn and teachers teach. Majeedia Trust sponsors the maintenance and upkeep of schools that serve the community.

The same principles apply: careful assessment, responsible allocation and accurate records.

imageAlt.en: A newly rebuilt two-storey school building with brick columns and freshly painted walls
